subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding
stimulus: numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) The angel took down his request and went away. (b) His name was Abu Ben Adhem. (c) Abu then requested him to put his name in the list because he loved mankind and his fellow brothers. (d) He again appeared the next night and showed Abu that his name was at the top of the list. (e) Suddenly he woke up and saw an angel who was writing the names of the persons who loved God. (f) Once upon a time, there was an honest and pious man. (g) He asked the angel if his name was there and in reply the angel said that his name was not there. (h) He was once sleeping peacefully. Part−B : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: Rearranging 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 f a h g d b e c Long long ago, there lived a rich man. He had only one son named Sindbad. Sindbad's father died when he was only sixteen. Sindbad, having inherited all his father's vast wealth, many of his relatives and friends gathered round to look after him. Sindbad, a young and inexperienced boy, spent money extravagantly for his relatives and friends. Soon he fell in economic difficulty. He went to his friends and relatives for help, but none helped him. At last, one of his father’s friends helped him start a business and being successful in it, he became rich again. Part−B : Writing Test See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 245
